rule: Walk counter per step; each block of steps (set by survival skill) runs a roll and heals a day's rest. Roll only outside towns: per-cell chance class sets a three-dice threshold; under it means an encounter. Rare gate only after an encounter: three dice plus Luck plus two per Explorer rank, minus five, must reach 18; then a d100 over six bands, each band once per game (mask saved with the game; all six used means generic only). Scene: the special scene, or one of the terrain's random scenes picked uniformly. Auto-travel to a town runs the steps and the heal but no roll.
